target.statement: 95% profile-score confidence interval for the intercept-slope covariance ψ2 in the autism socialization linear mixed model: (-34.566, -18.401)
target.dataset: WWGbook autism socialization data (610 scores, 158 children)

compute.basis: Small n=610 dataset, r=4 covariance parameters, paper reports ~0.5 s per full interval set in R; cost is dominated by installing R + reconf and downloading WWGbook, then a single fit and interval inversion.

blockers: Requires R and the reconf package (installable from GitHub); no GPU or large data needed
title: Score-based confidence intervals for variance-covariance parameters in linear mixed models
